title: Espresso machine
prompt: a home espresso machine: fill the tank, switch on, lock the portafilter, pull a shot into a cup, steam milk; see-through shows the pump, boiler, thermoblock, group head and steam wand path

title: Vending machine
prompt: a snack vending machine: insert a coin, type a code on the keypad, the spiral turns and the snack drops to the tray; see-through shows the coin mech, spiral motors, drop sensor and refrigeration

title: Toaster
prompt: how does a toaster know when to pop? a two-slot toaster: put in bread, push the lever, it browns and pops; see-through shows the heating elements, carriage, spring, latch and bimetal strip

title: Microwave
prompt: a countertop microwave: open the door, put in a bowl, set the time, start; the turntable spins and the food steams; see-through shows the magnetron, waveguide, transformer, fan and door interlock

title: Pencil sharpener
prompt: a desk-clamp crank pencil sharpener: insert a pencil, turn the crank, shavings fall into the drawer, pull out a sharp pencil; see-through shows the planetary helical cutters, gear train and clamp

title: Wind-up toy
prompt: a tin wind-up walking toy: turn the key to wind it, release and it walks; see-through shows the mainspring, gear train, escapement-like governor and leg cams

title: Traffic light
prompt: a pedestrian crossing traffic light: press the button, the cars' light goes amber then red, the walk signal lights and beeps, then it cycles back; see-through shows the controller cabinet, relays, LED modules and the push-button wiring

title: Smoke alarm
prompt: a ceiling smoke alarm: press test, blow smoke into it and it sounds, hush it, replace the battery; see-through shows the photoelectric chamber, LED, photodiode, piezo horn and battery

title: Fridge
prompt: a kitchen fridge-freezer: open the door, put in food, the light comes on, the compressor runs when the door is left open; see-through shows the compressor, condenser coils, evaporator, capillary tube and thermostat

title: Toilet flush
prompt: how does a toilet flush? a toilet with a cistern: press the flush, water rushes down, the cistern refills and stops itself; see-through shows the flush valve, siphon, float, fill valve and overflow tube

title: Capsule toy machine
prompt: a Japanese gashapon capsule toy machine: insert coins, turn the knob, a capsule drops and you open it; see-through shows the coin mechanism, agitator wheel, capsule gate and chute

title: Food truck
prompt: a taco food truck: open the serving hatch, order, the cook grills and hands out a plate; see-through shows the griddle, fridge, generator, water tanks, propane and serving window

title: Pour-over coffee set
prompt: a pour-over coffee set on a board: grind beans, put a filter in the dripper, pour hot water from a gooseneck kettle, coffee drips into the carafe; see-through shows the grinder burrs and the water path through the grounds

title: Desk lamp
prompt: an articulated desk lamp on a desk: switch it on, dim it, bend the arm, tilt the head; see-through shows the springs, joints, wiring, driver board and LED array

title: Electric kettle
prompt: an electric kettle that boils, then clicks itself off when done; show how it knows when to stop: see-through shows the heating element, steam tube, bimetal switch and base contacts

title: Desk fan
prompt: a desk fan: switch through speeds, turn on oscillation, tilt the head; see-through shows the motor, gearbox, oscillation crank, blades and guard

title: Claw machine
prompt: an arcade claw machine: insert a coin, steer the claw with the keypad, drop it, maybe win a prize to the chute; see-through shows the gantry, motors, claw solenoid, harness and coin path

title: Vacuum cleaner
prompt: an upright vacuum cleaner: switch on, push over dust, empty the bin; see-through shows the motor, fan, cyclone, filters, brush roll and belt

title: Blender
prompt: a countertop blender: add fruit, lock the lid, pulse and blend, pour; see-through shows the motor, coupling, blade assembly and speed switch

title: Toilet booth
prompt: a self-cleaning street toilet booth: pay, the door slides open, use it, the door closes and a wash cycle runs; see-through shows the door motor, flush tank, floor wash jets, sensors and controller

title: Gumball machine
prompt: a gumball machine where I can put in a coin and turn the crank; a gumball rolls down the chute; see-through shows the coin mechanism, dispensing wheel, agitator and chute

title: Record player
prompt: a record player: put on a record, drop the needle and it plays, lift the arm; see-through shows the motor, belt, platter bearing, tonearm pivot, cartridge and preamp

title: Music box
prompt: a wooden music box: wind the key, open the lid and it plays while a dancer turns; see-through shows the spring, governor, pinned cylinder and steel comb

title: Photo booth
prompt: a photo booth: pull the curtain, pay, pose, flash, a strip of photos prints out of the slot; see-through shows the camera, flash, printer, coin mech and the seat

title: Arcade cabinet
prompt: an arcade cabinet with a playable little game on the keypad: insert a coin, play, game over; see-through shows the CRT, PCB, power supply, speaker, coin door and joystick wiring

title: Arduino Uno
prompt: an Arduino Uno board on a desk: plug in USB, upload a sketch, the onboard LED blinks, wire an LED to pin 13; see-through labels the ATmega328P, USB chip, voltage regulator, crystal, reset button and header pins

title: Raspberry Pi 5
prompt: a Raspberry Pi 5 board: insert the microSD card, plug in power, it boots and the activity LED blinks, plug in HDMI; see-through labels the SoC, RAM, RP1 I/O chip, PMIC, USB and Ethernet ports, GPIO header

title: L298N motor driver
prompt: an L298N dual H-bridge motor driver module wired to a DC motor and a battery: set direction, enable, the motor spins, reverse it; see-through shows the H-bridge transistors in the chip, heat sink, diodes, regulator and screw terminals

title: How an LLM works
prompt: how does a large language model work? an isometric machine that takes a sentence in: tokenize, embed, run through transformer layers with attention, sample the next word, repeat; buttons step through each stage and labels light up

title: Hand water pump
prompt: a cast-iron village hand water pump: lift and push the handle, water rises and pours from the spout, fill a bucket; see-through shows the piston, two check valves, rising main and the well below

title: Flashlight
prompt: a handheld flashlight: slide the switch, it lights, focus the beam, unscrew the cap and swap the batteries; see-through shows the batteries, spring, switch contacts, LED, reflector and lens

title: Wi-Fi router
prompt: a home Wi-Fi router: plug in the WAN cable, power on, LEDs blink as a phone connects and a packet travels from phone to internet; see-through shows the SoC, radios, antennas, Ethernet switch, power supply and the packet path

title: Robot vacuum
prompt: a round robot vacuum: press clean, it drives off its dock, bumps a wall, turns, picks up dust, returns to dock; see-through shows the lidar, bumper switches, drive motors, brush roll, suction fan, bin and battery

title: Mechanical keyboard key
prompt: a single mechanical keyboard switch with its keycap, modelled large: press the key, the stem slides, the leaf contacts close and the LED under it lights; see-through shows the stem, spring, housing, contact leaves, PCB and backlight LED

title: Laptop
prompt: a laptop: open the lid, press power, it boots, plug in the charger, the fan spins up under load; see-through shows the motherboard, CPU with heat pipe and fan, battery, SSD, speakers, hinge and display cable

title: Mechanical watch
prompt: how does a mechanical watch keep time? an automatic wristwatch modelled large: wind the crown, set the hands, let it run; see-through shows the mainspring barrel, gear train, escapement with balance wheel and pallet fork, rotor and jewels, the escapement ticking

title: Pin tumbler lock
prompt: how does a key open a lock? a pin tumbler door lock modelled large: insert the right key, the pins line up at the shear line, turn, the bolt withdraws; try a wrong key and it won't turn; see-through shows key pins, driver pins, springs, plug, shear line, cam and deadbolt

title: Four-stroke engine
prompt: a single-cylinder four-stroke petrol engine on a stand: turn the key to crank, it runs through intake, compression, power, exhaust; throttle up; see-through shows the piston, crankshaft, connecting rod, camshaft, valves, spark plug, carburettor and flywheel

title: Bicycle derailleur gears
prompt: the rear half of a bicycle on a stand: pedal, shift up and down, the derailleur moves the chain across the cassette and the wheel speeds change; see-through shows the shifter cable, derailleur parallelogram, jockey wheels, cassette, freehub and chain

title: Piano action
prompt: how does a piano make a sound? one grand piano key and its action modelled large: press the key, the hammer flies and strikes the string, the damper lifts, release and it falls back; press the pedal; see-through shows the key, wippen, jack, repetition lever, hammer, damper, string and soundboard

title: Elevator
prompt: a three-floor traction elevator with the shaft cut open: press a floor button, the doors close, the car rises on its ropes while the counterweight falls, doors open; see-through shows the motor and sheave in the machine room, ropes, counterweight, guide rails, buffers and safety brake

title: Sewing machine
prompt: a domestic sewing machine: thread it, lower the presser foot, press the pedal and it stitches a seam across fabric; see-through shows the motor, belt, handwheel, needle bar, take-up lever, bobbin, hook and feed dogs forming a lockstitch

title: 3D printer
prompt: a desktop FDM 3D printer: load filament, heat the bed and nozzle, start a print and watch a small part grow layer by layer, remove it; see-through shows the stepper motors, belts, lead screw, extruder gears, hotend, heated bed and mainboard

title: Hard disk drive
prompt: a 3.5-inch hard disk drive with the lid off, modelled large: power on, the platters spin up, read a file and the arm seeks across the tracks, park the heads; see-through shows the spindle motor, platters, actuator arm, voice coil, read heads, controller board and SATA connector

title: Heat pump
prompt: how does a heat pump heat a house? an outdoor heat pump unit with an indoor wall unit: switch to heat, the refrigerant cycles and the room warms; switch to cool and the cycle reverses; see-through shows the compressor, reversing valve, expansion valve, outdoor coil and fan, indoor coil and fan, and refrigerant flow

title: Wind turbine
prompt: a wind turbine with the nacelle cut open: the wind picks up, the blades pitch and turn, the generator lights a house at the base, yaw to face the wind, brake in a storm; see-through shows the hub, pitch motors, main shaft, gearbox, generator, yaw drive and tower cables

title: Jet engine
prompt: how does a jet engine work? a turbofan engine on a test stand: start, spool up, throttle, the fan and compressor spin, fuel ignites, exhaust thrust; see-through shows the fan, low and high pressure compressors, combustor, turbines, shafts and nozzle with air flow lit

title: DSLR camera
prompt: a DSLR camera on a table, modelled large: look through the viewfinder, half-press to focus, press the shutter and the mirror flips and the shutter curtains run, switch to live view; see-through shows the lens elements, aperture, mirror, pentaprism, focusing screen, shutter curtains, sensor and battery

title: Click pen
prompt: how does a click pen work? a retractable ballpoint pen modelled very large: click the button and the tip comes out, click again and it retracts; see-through shows the plunger, cam body, rotating cam, spring, ink cartridge and ball tip

title: Combination padlock
prompt: how does a combination lock know the code? a dial combination padlock modelled large: turn the dial to each number, the three cams line up their notches, pull the shackle open, reset; wrong code stays locked; see-through shows the dial, spindle, three wheels with notches, fence, lever and shackle latch

title: Dishwasher
prompt: a built-in dishwasher: open the door, load plates, add a tablet, start; it fills, sprays, drains, dries; see-through shows the inlet valve, circulation pump, spray arms, heater, filter, drain pump and detergent dispenser

title: Escalator
prompt: a short escalator between two floors with a person riding it: start it, ride up, reverse direction, emergency stop; see-through shows the drive motor, step chain, step wheels on tracks, handrail drive, comb plates and the steps flattening at the landings
